overview: A trading pattern discovery engine that loads market data, generates features, finds patterns, validates them, and reports results with Internet Identity persistence.
features: Fix the black-screen crash with recoverable error boundaries
Direction-adjusted MFE/MAE ratio for bearish and bullish patterns
MFE/MAE ratio filter with Off, Positive-only, and Auto-find modes
Hold-window auto-find that grid-searches the best setting
Per-feature manual range overrides complementing auto-quartile bucketing
Save and load discovery runs with Internet Identity login
Completed Validation tab with cross-symbol survival and breakdown panel
Rebuilt Report tab as a structured readable document
